summary: Iteration 130: Live Incident War Room - All 28 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI fully tested with Playwright. War Room feature is working end-to-end: create war room (title required, auto public_slug, auto client_name lookup, opening system message), list rooms (excludes resolved by default), get room by ID, post chat messages (auto-adds participant), update status (investigating/identified/monitoring/resolved with system messages), update ETA, resolve with notes. PUBLIC page works WITHOUT authentication and correctly filters internal chat messages (shows only system/status messages). All data-testids present and working.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - minor cosmetic issue, doesn't affect functionality

POST /api/warroom: Auto-generates public_slug via secrets.token_urlsafe(8) (correct)
POST /api/warroom: Creates opening system message 'War room opened by {user}' (correct)
GET /api/warroom: Excludes resolved by default, includes with include_resolved=true (correct)
GET /api/warroom/{id}: Returns full war room with messages, participants, similar_incidents (correct)
POST /api/warroom/{id}/messages: Returns 400 when body missing (correct)
POST /api/warroom/{id}/messages: Auto-adds participant if new (correct)
POST /api/warroom/{id}/status: Returns 400 for invalid status (correct)
POST /api/warroom/{id}/status: Adds system message on status change (correct)
POST /api/warroom/{id}/status: Sets resolved_at when status=resolved (correct)
POST /api/warroom/{id}/resolve: Sets status=resolved, resolved_at, resolved_notes (correct)
GET /api/warroom/public/{slug}: NO AUTH required (correct)
GET /api/warroom/public/{slug}: Returns reduced payload without internal fields (correct)
GET /api/warroom/public/{slug}: Filters messages to only kind=status/system (hides chat) (correct)
All authenticated endpoints require valid token (401/403 without)

Frontend chat: Messages appear in list, participant tracking working
